Definition: from G2596 and G4724; to put down, i.e. quell:--appease, quiet.
BiblicalUsage: The townclerk appeased the people and said these things cannot be spoken against, so ye ought to be quiet and do nothing rashly.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the townclerk's calm saved the church that day, and God can use a steady voice in a loud crowd.
